Container.Name: Torrent-Maker-Pro
Container.Support: Use the contact button in de app
Container.Overview: A lightning-fast WebUI to locally generate .torrent files directly from your Unraid disks. No upload time, everything happens directly on your server! ⚠️ IMPORTANT: By default, this app uses port 8080. If port 8080 is already in use on your Unraid server, please change the 'WebUI Port' (Host Port) below to another free port (e.g., 8081 or 8282) to allow the app to start successfully.
Container.Changes: ### Version 2.3.6 - Fix: The Google Translate bar and iframes are now completely hidden to prevent them from shifting the interface layout.

Config.Name: WebUI Port
Config.Description: The port on which the application is accessible. ⚠️ Change this if 8080 is already in use!

Config.Name: Storage (Torrents)
Config.Description: The directory on your Unraid server where the .torrent files will be saved.

Config.Name: Files (Source)
Config.Description: The directory on your Unraid server containing the original files you want to create a torrent from (Read-only).

Config.Name: Discord Webhook (Optional)
Config.Description: Paste your Discord Webhook URL here to automatically receive a notification when all torrents are generated.
